jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit  yext.com .

Product Managers at Yext lead product development from strategy to design and execution by breaking down complex problems and customer needs. Day-to-day you will meet with customers and work closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, and Go-to-Market teams to drive software development from start to finish. This role is highly cross-functional, with constant opportunities to learn, innovate, and make a meaningful impact across the business.

As a Product Manager focused on Consumer Experience, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for the products that power direct engagement between businesses and their customers. You will help define how organizations communicate at scale while maintaining personalized, compliant, and high-quality interactions.

You will play a key role in shaping the future of AI-powered and automated communications.

What You’ll Do

- Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle for 1:1 communication products, from ideation through launch and iteration.

- Define the vision and roadmap for messaging and communication capabilities across channels such as messaging platforms, reviews and emerging conversational interfaces.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver intuitive communication experiences that drive customer engagement and business outcomes.

- Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to understand communication workflows, compliance needs, and engagement strategies across distributed teams.

- Design systems that enable scalable, personalized, and automated communication while maintaining strong governance and brand control.

- Investigate and analyze requests from customers, partners, and stakeholders, translating them into product opportunities and driving implementation.

- Coordinate feature launches including testing, beta programs, documentation, training, customer communication, and adoption measurement.

- Partner with ecosystem and channel partners to expand communication capabilities and integrations.

- Present and communicate product vision, roadmap, and capabilities to internal and external audiences.

What You Have

- 2-5+ years of product management experience in a technology-driven company, with a track record of successfully launching and iterating products.

- Experience building products in messaging, communications platforms, conversational interfaces, CRM engagement tools, or customer experience platforms.

- Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to inspire cross-functional teams and align stakeholders.

- A strong product mindset with the ability to connect vision to measurable customer and business outcomes.

- Strong time-management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Platform-level thinking and the ability to identify patterns across communication use cases and channels.

- Ability to simplify complex systems and translate technical concepts into clear product narratives.

- Experience with automation, AI-driven workflows, or agentic systems for customer engagement is a plus.

- Experience building products for distributed teams, regulated industries, or compliance-sensitive communication environments is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit  yext.com .

The Paradigm Shift: Why This Role Exists

The classical era of software development where a Product Manager sits in meetings for months, writes a 30-page product requirement document (PRD), and throws it over a wall to engineering to build is no longer the PM job.

With the rise of AI assistants, rapid prototyping tools, and "vibe coding," the structural bottleneck isn't writing code anymore. It’s having  impeccable product taste, deep domain nuance, and the execution speed to find the right solution before the market shifts.

At Yext, we are the trusted source of truth for the world's largest multi-location enterprises for their marketing. Our platform ensures that when a consumer asks an AI assistant or a search engine about a brand, the answer is accurate, localized, and context-aware.

We don't need an agile process coordinator.  We need a high-agency Product Builder.

What You Will Do

You will drive key innovation within one of our core anchors, Competitive Intelligence, Data Syndication, or Consumer Experience, and are responsible for bringing to life a vision of autonomous marketing built for the world of AI Search.

- Prototype at the Speed of Thought: You won't wait for engineering or design  bandwidth to validate an idea. You will actively use modern tools (Claude, Codex, Cursor) to spin up functional proofs-of-concept, mockups, or automated data pipelines to de-risk ideas, with real users, by lunchtime.

- Obsessively Refine Product Taste: You are a perpetual student of the craft and the customers domain. Whether through deep-dive analysis of industry trends and competitors, constant experimentation with emerging AI interfaces, or engaging in active feedback loops with power users, you relentlessly cultivate the domain nuance required to build industry-defining search products.

- You measure outcomes: You balance high-speed prototyping with deep operational discipline, instrumenting analytics and benchmarking performance to deliver high-impact results. You possess a pragmatic approach to prioritization, ruthlessly focusing on the 20% of effort that drives 80% of business outcomes.

- Scale to Production and take to Market: You will partner with world-class engineering squads to harden your high-conviction prototypes into scalable, secure, and highly instrumented global enterprise features. You will ensure the follow through of our solutions out to the market and to our customers, to ensure you have solved the problem.

Who You Are

You might be an ex-founder who loves the early-stage chaos. You might be a highly technical SEO or marketing-technology architect who has been hacking custom scripts together for years. Or you might be an engineer who realized they care far more about user psychology than codebase optimization. Or you are an experienced PM who has realized the job has changed and you want to be a part of something that is moving fast and has ambition.

We are filtering for four core superpowers:

- Customer Empathy: You are genuinely interested in the world of marketing and seek to connect with our customers to understand their goals and objectives and how we can help them succeed.

- Foresight & Vision: You possess a proven ability to anticipate future trends and "see around corners." You maintain a natural, persistent curiosity regarding the future of technology.

- AI Curiosity & Architecture Expertise: You use LLMs, vector databases, and RAG daily. You understand the shift from "blue links" to conversational interfaces and the importance of structured data, semantic search, and schema.org.

- An Engineering Mindset for Rigor: You are level-headed. While you love the speed of a prototype, you possess the operational discipline to instrument analytics, benchmark product performance, and ruthlessly prioritize the 20% of effort that drives 80% of business outcomes.

What we DON'T care about:

- Certification in Agile/Scrum frameworks.

- An MBA or a mandatory computer science degree (though a technical background is highly valued, we care about what you can build, not your credentials).

- 5+ years of sitting in a legacy PM seat writing Jira tickets.

What we DO care about:

- A portfolio or track record of building and shipping things people actually use; knowing that building a solution is only halfway to ensure it’s delivering value.

- Intense customer empathy and the ability to speak the language of enterprise data buyers.

- Accountability and high agency.

Pay ranges at Yext are established based on an analysis of salaries for positions with a similar level of accountability and impact in the relevant labor market. Salary levels are expected to change to reflect an employee’s job performance (results and impact) over time. Salaries at the time of hire are typically offered in the lower to middle of the above-referenced range in order to provide the opportunity to reflect performance-based increases over time. In addition to base salaries, employees at Yext are typically eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits including medical, dental and vision benefits; life insurance; short term and long-term disability; 401(k) retirement plan; and vacation and sick leave. Successful candidates may also be eligible for variable pay programs based on performance relative to goals and targets.
